title: 第343章 消散第342章 调职
slug: 以下犯上徒弟着实貌美
lines: 赵归涯沉默了一会儿，金色的横瞳在烛光下微微收缩，像是在斟酌措辞。
“纸纸，你们不会失败的。”
他最终只是这样说了一句，声音轻得像一片落在水面上的花瓣。
楚安芷没有被他带偏，握着他手的力道又紧了几分：“回答我。”
赵归涯低头看着她握着自己的手，那只手骨节分明，指尖微凉，力道大得像要把他的骨头握碎。
他叹了口气，抬起另一只手覆上她的手背，声音里带着几分无奈：“你什么时候变得这么爱刨根问底了？”
“从你开始瞒我的时候。”
赵归涯被她这句话噎了一下，嘴角动了动，到底没说出什么反驳的话来。
书房里安静了片刻，只有烛火偶尔发出的细微噼啪声。
赵归涯靠在椅背上，仰头看着书房的房梁，浅粉色的长发从肩侧垂落，金色的横瞳在烛光下泛着淡淡的光。
“如果你们失败了。”他慢慢开口，声音不高不低，像是在说一件与自己毫不相干的事情，“我会消散，然后再很久之后再次重组，成为一个和现在的我本源相同的新神。”
楚安芷握着他手的力道又紧了几分，指节泛出青白。
“重组之后呢？”她的声音微微发紧，“你还是你吗？”
赵归涯沉默了一瞬，仔细思考着这个问题。
把他记忆里重组后的悔和消散前的魈做了个对比。
“不算了。”他说得很轻，像是在说一件早已接受了的事实，“本源和记忆相同，但那些记忆里所付出的情感不会恢复。以至于性格和行为习惯都会大相径庭。就像是同一棵树上的两片叶子，看着像，但终究不是同一片。”
楚安芷的手颤了一下。
那颤抖很轻微，轻微到如果不仔细看根本察觉不到。
但赵归涯感觉到了，从两人交握的指尖，从她微微发凉的掌心，从她忽然屏住的呼吸。
他垂下眼眸，横瞳在烛光中敛去了几分锐利，变得柔软而温润。
“但那只是最坏的情况。”他反手握住她的手，拇指在她手背上轻轻摩挲了一下，声音放得很轻很轻，“纸纸，你们不会失败的。”
楚安芷没有说话。
她低着头，浅色的睫毛在眼底投下一片扇形的阴影，遮住了她眼中翻涌的情绪。
赵归涯看着她的侧脸，忽然觉得有点慌。
他认识她三辈子，见过她执剑杀伐的模样，见过她运筹帷幄的模样，见过她冷静自持到近乎冷漠的模样，见过她生气时眼底翻涌着雷霆万钧却依旧面不改色的模样……
但他很少见她这样。
沉默着，低着头，一句话也不说，只有握着他的那只手越收越紧，像是溺水的人抓住了最后一块浮木。
“纸纸。”他轻声唤她，想抬手去拨她垂落的发丝，却被她握着手抽不出来，只能微微侧头去看她的脸，“你别这样……”
楚安芷终于抬起头。
她的眼眶是红的，但没有泪。
她只是看着他，那双素来沉静如水的眼睛里，此刻像是打翻了砚台，墨色的情绪翻涌着、翻滚着，却始终没有溢出来。
“你早就知道。”她的声音有些哑，像是砂纸磨过的，“从你选择死亡方式的时候就知道，你给自己留的从来不是退路。”
赵归涯张了张嘴，想说什么，又被她截断了。
“你选了痛觉解封。”楚安芷一字一句，每个字都像是从牙缝里挤出来的，“你选了把所有的代价都背在自己身上。你选了……如果失败了，就让自己变成另一个人。”
content_en:
Zhao Guiya was silent for a while, and his golden pupils shrank slightly in the candlelight, as if he was considering his words.
"Paper, you will not fail."
He finally just said this, his voice as soft as a petal falling on the water.
Chu Anzhi was not led astray by him, and held his hand a little tighter: "Answer me."
Zhao Guiya lowered his head and looked at the hand she was holding on to him. The hand had distinct joints, the fingertips were slightly cold, and the strength was so strong that it seemed like she was going to break his bones.
He sighed, raised his other hand to cover the back of her hand, and said with a hint of helplessness in his voice: "When did you become so inquisitive?"
"Since you started hiding it from me."
Zhao Guiya choked at her words, and the corners of his mouth moved, but he didn't say anything to refute.
The study was quiet for a moment, except for the occasional faint crackle of the candlelight.
Zhao Guiya leaned back on the chair and looked up at the beams of the study room. His long light pink hair hung down from his shoulders, and his golden horizontal pupils glowed faintly in the candlelight.
"If you fail." He spoke slowly, his voice neither high nor low, as if he was talking about something that had nothing to do with him. "I will dissipate, and then reorganize again after a long time, becoming a new god with the same origin as me now."
Chu Anzhi held his hand a little tighter, and her knuckles turned blue and white.
"What happens after the reorganization?" Her voice was slightly tight, "Are you still you?"
Zhao Guiya was silent for a moment, thinking about this question carefully.
Comparing the regret after the reorganization in his memory with the mandrill before dissipation.
"Forget it." He said very lightly, as if he was talking about a fact that he had already accepted. "The origin and memory are the same, but the emotions invested in those memories will not be restored. So that the personality and behavioral habits will be very different. It's like two leaves on the same tree. They look similar, but they are not the same leaf after all."
Chu Anzhi's hand trembled.
The tremor was very slight, so slight that you couldn't even notice it if you didn't look carefully.
But Zhao Guiya felt it, from the fingertips of the two of them intertwined, from the slightly cold palm of her hand, from the breath she suddenly held.
He lowered his eyes, and his pupils lost some of their sharpness in the candlelight, becoming soft and gentle.
"But that's just the worst case scenario." He held her hand with his backhand, gently rubbed his thumb on the back of her hand, and said in a very soft voice, "Zhi Zhi, you will not fail."
Chu Anzhi said nothing.
She lowered her head, and her light eyelashes cast a fan-shaped shadow under her eyes, covering the surging emotions in her eyes.
Zhao Guiya looked at her profile and suddenly felt a little panicked.
He has known her for three lifetimes. He has seen her killing with a sword, seen her strategizing, seen her calm and self-possessed to the point of being indifferent, seen her eyes surging with thunder but still remaining calm when she is angry...
But he rarely saw her like this.
Silent, head lowered, not saying a word, only the hand holding him tightened, like a drowning man grabbing the last piece of driftwood.
"Paper." He called her softly, and wanted to raise his hand to brush her hanging hair, but she held her hand and couldn't pull it out. He could only turn his head slightly to look at her face, "Don't do this..."
Chu Anzhi finally raised her head.
Her eyes were red, but there were no tears.
She just looked at him, her eyes that were always as calm as water seemed to have knocked over an inkstone at this moment, the dark emotions were surging and rolling, but they never overflowed.
"You have known for a long time." Her voice was a little hoarse, as if it had been polished by sandpaper. "I knew from the time you chose the way to die that the way you left for yourself was never a way out."
Zhao Guiya opened his mouth to say something, but she cut him off again.
"You chose to unblock the pain." Chu Anzhi said every word as if squeezed out from between her teeth, "You chose to bear all the costs on yourself. You chose...if you fail, let yourself become another person."
